name: every_starter
caption:
IF OUR CORE FIVE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🎤 PG Steph Curry = Jigglypuff: sings the whole room to sleep. Night night. 27.8 a night, 45.7% from three
🐴 SG Brandin Podziemski = Mudsdale: its ability is Stamina. All 82 games last season, 16.5 a night this year
🔥 SF Yaxel Lendeborg = Charmeleon: a rookie, already evolving. 20.2 a night
📢 PF Draymond Green = Exploud: its bellow shakes the ground. 7.1 assists a night
🦖 C Al Horford = Aerodactyl: a fossil brought back from amber. 40 and still flying

Who would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If our core five were Pokemon, who'd be who?
Point guard. Steph Curry is Jigglypuff.
It sings a song that puts the whole room to sleep. Sound familiar? Night night.
beats.dlg: IT SINGS THE ROOM TO SLEEP.|NIGHT NIGHT.

beats.vo: Twenty-seven point eight a night, and forty-five point seven percent from three.
Shooting guard. Brandin Podziemski is Mudsdale.
Its ability is Stamina. Podz played all eighty-two games last season.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY: STAMINA.|ALL 82 GAMES LAST SEASON.

beats.vo: Small forward. Yaxel Lendeborg is Charmeleon.
Power forward. Draymond Green is Exploud.
Its bellow can trigger earthquakes. The loudest voice on our floor.
beats.dlg: ITS BELLOW SHAKES THE GROUND.|THE LOUDEST VOICE WE HAVE.

beats.vo: Seven point one assists a night.
A fossil brought back from amber. Forty years old, and still flying.
beats.dlg: A FOSSIL FROM AMBER.|40 AND STILL FLYING.

beats.vo: That's a party we're taking into any building.
